summary: Executed API regression and frontend smoke testing for auth, RBAC, dashboard data, AI ingestion, WebSocket-backed UI, and all nine navigation pages. 5/6 backend tests passed; one critical ingestion authorization test failed. Frontend pages and viewer Users restriction rendered successfully.

critical.issue: Accepts an arbitrary X-AI-Engine-Key and returns 200 while persisting a detection. Invalid key 'wrong-key' reproduced as success.

action_items: Enforce authentication on /api/ai/ingest/detection: reject missing or incorrect X-AI-Engine-Key with 401/403 and do not write detection records.
Remove production fallbacks for MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, admin credentials, and AI key; fail fast when required environment variables are absent.
Resolve React exhaustive-deps warnings before production hardening (Dashboard, Alerts, LiveCameras, Watchlist, CameraManagement, DetectionHistory, UsersAccess).
critical_code_review_comments: The ingestion handler contains a no-op authorization branch (pass), making the external AI ingestion endpoint unauthenticated despite the stated API-key contract.
server.py is a single 1500+ line module; split auth, camera, alert, ingestion, and seed concerns into focused modules in a follow-up refactor.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. One API_TEST_SUBJECT detection was intentionally ingested using the valid AI key during testing; invalid-key test also created an unwanted detection because of the confirmed bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth for all three supplied accounts, Secure cookies, auth/me, viewer CAM-01/CAM-02-only visibility, CAM-03 403, core data endpoints, valid ingestion, operator diagnostics, all nine routes, and viewer /users 403 were tested. Retest invalid/missing AI key and verify no detection is persisted.
rca of the issue: In ingest_ai_detection, authenticated is computed but the following condition has only pass: `if not authenticated and x_ai_engine_key != "sentinel_ai_engine_key_live_2026": pass`. Execution then proceeds to database insertion. Replace the no-op with HTTPException(status_code=401 or 403), and validate before any camera lookup or write.
